contract: Offline Sightcraft comparison gallery at 1440x1000 and 390x844. Primary actions open the original/adapted pages or the Thai start guide. Adapted result additionally checked at 320px and with text increased to 200%. Original reference and adapted screenshots inspected visually.

accessibility.evidence: Named links, landmarks and image alternatives inspected; keyboard Tab shows a solid focus outline; Space opens/closes the adapted page details and opens gallery mobile comparison; CTA hash reaches #work. Main foreground/background contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1. This is a basic check, not a screen reader or comprehensive WCAG audit.

responsive.evidence: Exact viewport widths recorded through CDP, scrollWidth <= innerWidth on gallery at 1440 and 390 and result at 1440, 390, 320. Result text doubled from initial computed sizes at 390 without horizontal overflow; reviewed top screenshot. Thai navigation wraps and all text remains available.

loading.reason: Static local documents and images, with no asynchronous data request or application loading state.

empty.reason: The gallery ships with a fixed complete original example; no input form or empty collection.

error.reason: No application request, backend or upload. Missing local file failures are covered by the package checker, not a simulated UI state.

partial.reason: The gallery always shows complete local captures. Cropped-input uncertainty belongs to the instruction-only skill and is illustrated separately in CROPPED-CASE.md.

success.evidence: Both original/adapted desktop pages and screenshots load, all four gallery comparison images have nonzero natural width, and native links/disclosure work.

permission.reason: No credentials, upload, permission prompt or external service in the static gallery.

renderedEvidence.observation: Read and visually inspected desktop gallery: clear primary action, side-by-side original/adapted previews, output document links and Thai start guide.
Read and visually inspected mobile gallery: hero and comparisons stack, links and long Thai copy fit without horizontal overflow.
